role: retrospective information audit of the frozen V3 controller, with no new policy evaluation
registration_context: all 219 joint physical witnesses replayed; V3 April outcomes known, nomination-time failure classification unobserved

roster.library: all original 64 profiles, seed and integer projection unchanged
roster.reference: constant_0.50 only, already fixed and failed in all April windows
roster.selection_basis: April is the frozen unresolved development bottleneck; no selection of successful trajectories

control: V3 nominations and execution unchanged; append trace metadata only

information_contract.nomination_time: window start + floor(first failure relative minute/30)*30 -60 minutes
information_contract.decision_state: actual independent stocks immediately before that nomination, plus the two already pending unit nominations and the new nomination
information_contract.known_path: reconstruct up to the first failed minute using only BOAs received by the nomination time; retain exact gross-flow energy and within-minute extrema
information_contract.new_receipts: trace receipts after nomination that changed the executed path between decision and first failure
information_contract.baseline_clock: fixed half-hour decisions; offline future boundaries never become an observable

classification: known violation in the pending hour, already constrained by previous commitments
known violation during the newly nominated delivery slot
predicted prefix safe, actual violation after later receipts or revisions
validation: traced success flags and first failing minutes must exactly reproduce the saved V3 rows before interpreting labels
next_action: use the labels to choose between enforcing known inventory/path constraints at nomination and improving reserve response to later instructions; freeze any revised controller before testing it
limitations: development-only retrospective diagnosis; labels do not prove online impossibility, source benefit, or independent confirmation
